req.title: Reject empty title on create
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 422 when the title field of POST /tasks/ is missing.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the system should reject task creation requests with an empty title by returning an HTTP 422 status code. This behavior needs to be validated through a series of tests that cover positive, negative, and boundary cases. The tests ensure that the system behaves correctly when the title is provided, when it is missing, and when it is at the boundary of being valid.

tests.name: test_create_task_with_valid_title
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with a valid title.
expected: The response contains the created task with the specified title.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "New Task", "description": "A valid task description", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 201
assert response.json()["title"] == "New Task"

tests.name: test_create_task_with_empty_title
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ with an empty title.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the title is required.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"title": "", "description": "A task with empty title", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "title" in response.json()["detail"][0]["loc"]
assert response.json()["detail"][0]["msg"] == "ensure this value has at least 1 characters"

tests.name: test_create_task_without_title
preconditions: The database is initialized with pre-loaded tasks.
actions: Send a POST request to /tasks/ without a title field.
expected: The response contains an error message indicating the title is required.
tests.executable:
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.post(
    "/tasks/",
    json={"description": "A task without title", "completed": False}
)

assert response.status_code == 422
assert "title" in response.json()["detail"][0]["loc"]
assert response.json()["detail"][0]["msg"] == "field required"
